description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6230011891480 FILTER,FLASHLIGHT: Line 0001 Qty 25 UI HD Deliver To: By: 0062 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
